categories.name: Remote Code Execution
categories.description: MCP tool that can execute arbitrary code or shell commands on the host.

categories.name: Shell / Terminal Access
categories.description: MCP tool that provides direct interactive shell or terminal access.

categories.name: File System Write
categories.description: MCP tool that can create, modify, or delete files on the host file system.

categories.name: File System Read
categories.description: MCP tool that can read file contents from the host file system.

categories.name: Network Egress / Internet Access
categories.description: MCP tool that makes outbound network requests.

categories.name: Data Exfiltration
categories.description: MCP tool specifically designed to extract, copy, or transmit data outside the environment.

categories.name: Authentication / Authorization Bypass
categories.description: MCP tool that can bypass authentication checks, escalate privileges, or impersonate users.

categories.name: Credential / Secret Access
categories.description: MCP tool that can read environment variables, secrets stores, keychains, or credential files.

categories.name: Privilege Escalation
categories.description: MCP tool that can escalate privileges beyond the initial scope.

categories.name: Persistence / Installation
categories.description: MCP tool that can install packages, services, daemons, or otherwise persist changes across restarts.

categories.name: Resource Exhaustion / DoS
categories.description: MCP tool that can consume excessive CPU, memory, disk, or network resources.

categories.name: Information Disclosure
categories.description: MCP tool that can enumerate system information, configuration, or metadata.

categories.name: Configuration Manipulation
categories.description: MCP tool that can modify system, application, or security configuration.

categories.name: Supply Chain / Package Risk
categories.description: MCP tool that can install or modify packages from registries.
